sources.name: AvaloniaEdit and AvaloniaEdit.TextMate
localChanges: Projects target inherited net10.0 and Avalonia 12.1.3 without upstream packaging
TextMate references resolve to owned source projects
Native discontiguous MultiSelection, Ctrl+Alt-click caret creation, selection rendering and native input-command integration
Host-reported edit rejection with native undo rollback for input, commands, paste and search; clipboard retrieval does not hold a document update open

sources.name: TextMateSharp and TextMateSharp.Grammars
localChanges: Projects target inherited net10.0 without upstream signing/packaging

nativeReleaseGates: Build and headless UI behavioral tests with Avalonia 12.1.3
macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64/arm64, Linux glibc/musl x64/arm64 native Onigwrap loading and TextMate highlighting
IME composition/commit, dead keys, Unicode surrogate pairs and clipboard on each native platform
Discontiguous Ctrl+Alt-click carets, rectangular selection, insertion/deletion, movement and grouped undo/redo
Light/dark grammar theme, search/replace, folding, scrolling large files, diagnostics and runtime completion/hover/definition/rename
